screens.name: Home — empty omen and populated omen
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show the dominant gold orb, empty/populated omen and navigation; supplied runtime reports responsive Home, contrast and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Increase the example question’s visual prominence so it reads as useful inspiration above the orb.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent approach/transition composition, and supplied runtime specifies automatic advancement after 650ms or immediately with reduced motion.
findings: Avoid making the brief invitation essential reading because automatic advancement gives little reading time.

screens.name: Ask — Myself, normal text
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows explicit selected identity, labeled question and primary submit action with closely matched transition framing.
findings: Reduce discretionary space around the supporting orb to bring the question and submission action higher.

screens.name: Ask — Myself, enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows enlarged controls and a reachable submit button, but the question’s opening is clipped within the textarea.
findings: Give the enlarged question field enough initial height to expose the whole sample question without internal scrolling.

screens.name: Ask — Someone, normal text and entry variant
screens.evidence: Sheets 02 and 06 show selected Someone, First name and privacy context; supplied entry evidence reports mode switching, retained question and validation.
findings: Reclaim space above the form so the primary action is not partially below the initial viewport.

screens.name: Ask — Someone, 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheets 01 and 06 show doubled text with the selected checkmark wrapping above Someone and submission below the viewport; runtime reports scrollable layout checks.
findings: Stack the identity choices at enlarged text sizes so each checkmark stays beside its label.

screens.name: Follow-up card 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows a clear question, four separated responses and 1 of 3 progress; supplied runtime reports keyboard advancement, focus movement and Back preservation.
findings: Add a quiet indication that choosing a preset answer advances immediately.

screens.name: Follow-up card 2
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves question/answer placement through transition samples and updates the progress label to 2 of 3.
findings: Clarify immediate advancement before users commit to a response.

screens.name: Follow-up card 3
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the final synthetic stress card with readable choices and 3 of 3 progress.
findings: Indicate that selecting this final response starts forecast generation.

screens.name: Custom answer — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show persistent question context, Choices, an empty multiline input and disabled Continue; supplied runtime reports retained answers and focus return.
findings: Rename Choices to Back to choices to make the escape route explicit.

screens.name: Custom answer — enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows enlarged context, input and Continue; supplied runtime reports long-answer editing and a 390×500 constrained-viewport check.
findings: Keep the return-to-choices label explicit at enlarged sizes as well.

screens.name: Voice unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows Type your question as primary, Try voice again and a separate microphone failure notice.
findings: Place the failure explanation beside the fallback controls instead of separating it at the bottom of the screen.

screens.name: Age confirmation — normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show readable age choices at both sizes; supplied runtime reports persisted eligibility and an under-13 reload gate.
findings: Preserve the equally legible under-13 route when validating the final native layout.

screens.name: Birthday onboarding — normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show an optional YYYY-MM-DD field and Skip for now; supplied runtime reports actual invalid/valid onboarding and doubled field text.
findings: Explain why the year is requested when the stated personalization benefit is determining a Sun sign.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show single-choice instructions, four options, Meet the Ball, Back and Skip for now.
findings: Clarify whether Meet the Ball with no selection has the same effect as Skip for now.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — selected, including entry variant
screens.evidence: Sheets 06 and 12–13 show gold text, underline and checkmark selection; supplied runtime reports Space activation and exactly one programmatic selected state.
findings: Retain the checkmark and programmatic state together rather than relying on the gold treatment alone.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — 200%, selected and unselected
screens.evidence: Sheets 06 and 12 show enlarged headings and choices with Meet the Ball partly below the viewport; supplied runtime reports scrollable layouts and zero entry axe violations.
findings: Reduce discretionary vertical gaps to bring more of Meet the Ball into view without reducing text size.

screens.name: Planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows a stable orb-led loading composition, planning explanation, one-minute expectation, credit reassurance and Cancel.
findings: Expose an elapsed or delayed-state message when a request approaches the stated one-minute wait.

screens.name: Research
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 preserve loading composition while changing stage text to current-context research; supplied runtime reports timeout and cancellation coverage.
findings: Give the active stage more visual distinction from planning so progress is easier to perceive.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a clear failure, no-charge reassurance, Try again and Edit question; supplied runtime reports real connection recovery.
findings: Keep the explicit no-charge reassurance adjacent to retry in production error variants.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 adds Review answers to retry/edit recovery and maintains comparable transition framing; runtime reports retained answers on recovery.
findings: Preserve Review answers as a distinct recovery route alongside retry.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning and prediction
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows support, alternate-question/edit routes and no-credit/no-memory reassurance; runtime reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Put the supportive explanation before Find support near you so users understand the redirect before acting.

screens.name: Forecast reveal
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows a dominant forecast, qualification, date, Why and sharing hierarchy; runtime reports a real reading and export flow separately from the pictured fixture.
findings: Label the displayed date’s role explicitly so users can distinguish the prediction horizon from a check-back date.

screens.name: Why — free explanation expanded
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows persistent forecast context above a dense explanation and upgrade action; supplied runtime reports disclosure keyboard operation and focus return.
findings: Separate recorded context, assumptions and source limitations into short labeled blocks for long responses.

screens.name: Why — deeper evidence expanded, normal text
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows long preserved stress content with facts, assumptions and sources separated by headings and rules.
findings: Make long evidence blocks individually collapsible so the section outline remains easy to scan.

screens.name: Why — deeper evidence, 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows enlarged evidence where a single source title spans much of the viewport; runtime reports preserved content and accessible disclosure controls.
findings: Offer a compact source identity before each full title to preserve orientation during enlarged-text reading.

screens.name: Check-in — no outcome selected
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 places Did it come true and three response actions below the forecast while Share remains the strongest button.
findings: Give the outcome question greater emphasis than sharing when the screen’s task is checking in.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Yes
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a checked Yes, inline Saved status and a confirmation notice; runtime reports persisted history outcomes.
findings: Reduce the large confirmation notice once the persistent inline saved state is visible.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Not quite
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a checked Not quite, inline saved confirmation and a history notice beneath the action group.
findings: Use a more compact confirmation to avoid competing with the forecast and next actions.

screens.name: Outcome saved — Not yet
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a selected Not yet, persistent saved status and Still waiting to unfold notice.
findings: Keep pending confirmation compact so it does not occupy the remaining action area.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows an explicit empty state, local-storage explanation and Ask the Ball route with stable transition composition.
findings: Give Ask the Ball a stronger action treatment within the otherwise empty page.

screens.name: History — populated single entry
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a dated row with original question, forecast and check-back date; runtime reports history persistence.
findings: Use a readable localized check-back date instead of the ISO date string.

screens.name: History — long list and saved outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows multiple separated entries and a distinct Came true state; the lower row continues beneath the viewport.
findings: Provide a clearer row-opening affordance for users who want to revisit a forecast.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples and selected question
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 explicitly labels offline sample stars, Retry, the selected Love topic and Ask this too.
findings: Strengthen the selected star’s enclosing shape or outline so topic selection is recognizable beyond the small checkmark.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows an offline banner and Retry above disabled creation and sharing controls; supplied runtime confirms offline creation behavior.
findings: Place the offline reason directly beside the disabled creation action.

screens.name: Plans — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show selected yearly pricing, monthly alternative, packs and repeated simulation labeling; runtime reports simulated purchase and Restore.
findings: Bring the selected plan’s billing commitment closer to Continue with Plus.

screens.name: Plans — enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows readable stacked pricing and a wrapped primary action continuing below the viewport; runtime reports enlarged layout coverage.
findings: Keep a concise selected-plan summary immediately above the enlarged continuation action.

screens.name: Share — collapsed options
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows the artifact, Download image, privacy statement and collapsed Invite & remind; runtime reports real PNG export and failure recovery.
findings: Allow enlargement of the preview so users can inspect the exported text before downloading.

screens.name: Share — expanded options
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows Invite a friend and Remind me to check back under a disclosure without displacing the primary image action.
findings: State the destination or delivery method of each external action before activation.

screens.name: Share — 200%, collapsed and expanded
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows enlarged download and privacy text while the image preview remains small; supplied runtime reports enlarged Share contrast checks.
findings: Provide an accessible full-text equivalent of the preview beside the image inspection route.

screens.name: Story image preview
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows a larger portrait artifact, visible speculative qualification and Download image; runtime reports a real 1080×1920 PNG.
findings: Increase the exported qualification text slightly so it remains legible when a story is viewed at phone width.

screens.name: You — profile and empty memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 shows birth summary, edit routes, plan balance and an explicit empty memory state.
findings: Capitalize Gemini consistently as a displayed sign name.

screens.name: Birthday editor — normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 show a populated date field, Save birthday and Forget birthday at both sizes; supplied runtime reports profile editing.
findings: Replace Close birthday with a clearer editing-state label such as Cancel editing.

screens.name: Optional birth details — normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 shows birth time, city and disabled lookup/reveal actions; runtime reports live geocoding and a locally calculated result.
findings: Explain next to the disabled action that a city must be entered and selected before Moon and rising can be revealed.

screens.name: Settings controls — normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows labeled switches and enlarged navigation; supplied runtime reports full-row activation, keyboard handling, persistence and actual reduced-motion behavior.
findings: Keep scrolled content visibly separated from the pinned header so partial text does not appear attached to You.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use the illustrated orb as the hero; supplied runtime reports Home activation, stopped draws under reduced motion and current frame-timing checks.
findings: Reduce the supporting orb’s footprint on input-heavy screens while preserving its prominence on Home.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Home, Sky, History and You show labeled tabs with selected color/underline and raised Ask orb; runtime reports doubled labels and clearance checks.
findings: Give every tab a similarly explicit selected marker to reduce reliance on subtle gold emphasis.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The sheets show a compact wordmark or page title opposite remaining readings or a test-plan indicator.
findings: Clarify whether the underlined balance is actionable instead of leaving it visually between status and link.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream/brass buttons consistently mark primary actions, with disabled examples pictured and export busy/retry behavior described in runtime evidence.
findings: Preserve generous button height when labels wrap at 200% text.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold links and divided text rows represent secondary actions across editing, recovery, sharing and navigation.
findings: Use a consistent affordance for navigation links versus immediate actions.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 03–04 show generously separated choices; runtime reports Space/Enter, single advancement, moved focus and preserved answers.
findings: Signal automatic advancement before the first choice is made.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled serif textarea with a strong gold outline and retained question content described by runtime evidence.
findings: Simplify the doubled bottom-edge treatment so the input reads as one deliberate boundary.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01 and 06 demonstrate true enlargement but show clipping or extended internal content; supplied measurements confirm 24→48px question text.
findings: Increase initial textarea height with enlarged text to reduce nested scrolling and hidden question content.

components.name: Custom-answer input and Choices return
components.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show context, multiline input and disabled continuation; runtime reports retained long answers and focus restoration.
findings: Label the return action Back to choices.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 19 shows labeled switches with distinct positions, and runtime explicitly reports full-row targets, keyboard operation, persistence, focus and actual preference effects.
findings: Retain the full labeled row as the interactive target at every text size.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show populated and No omen today states with an explicit alternate action.
findings: Explain whether no omen reflects normal availability or a retrieval failure when that distinction is known.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 21 pairs labeled stars and a selected Love marker with a readable sample question and primary action.
findings: Add a stronger non-color selected shape around the active topic.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 explains invitation privacy and offline status while creation and friend-question controls are disabled.
findings: Tie each disabled action directly to its applicable offline or age restriction.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 08 shows date, question, forecast and either check-back date or persisted outcome in clearly separated rows.
findings: Add a quiet opening affordance and use a human-readable check-back date.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show yearly selection with checkmark, explicit annual charge, monthly alternative and enlarged wrapping.
findings: Keep the total billed amount visually closer to the selected option label.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 19–21 show a coherent portrait artifact whose forecast and qualifications become very small in the compact preview.
findings: Provide an enlarge-preview action and adjacent accessible text for inspecting the artifact.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error pages and notices show explicit failure/saved messages, retry or dismissal, with recovery and credit preservation reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Use compact notices near the relevant control instead of large detached bottom blocks.

components.name: Typography and spacing system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently distinguish serif narrative headings, italic ritual copy and sans-serif controls, with genuine 200% variants and sampled contrast evidence.
findings: Shorten line lengths and add stronger substructure to long explanatory passages.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist remains visually subordinate in settled and transition samples; runtime reports sampled composited contrast, stopped animations and current frame-timing passes.
findings: Retain the existing opacity restraint and reduced-motion behavior when adding new content surfaces.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Sheets 11–12 and 22–23 show YYYY-MM-DD onboarding and populated editing fields; runtime reports validation and exact text doubling.
findings: Keep a persistent Birthday label on the populated editor instead of relying on surrounding context.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show direct age choices at normal/200% sizes, with eligibility and decline persistence reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Verify the decline result and return route with the same enlarged-text coverage as the pictured choice screen.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 06 and 12–13 show clear single selection with checkmark, while current runtime reports keyboard switching, one selected state and normal/200% axe passes.
findings: Keep the selected marker visible alongside the label across future option wording changes.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 22–23 group sign, age band, birthday and editing routes without enclosing cards.
findings: Use consistent capitalization and readable date formatting in the summary.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheet 22 shows optional time/city inputs and disabled dependent actions; runtime reports successful live geocoding and calculation.
findings: Explain the required city-selection step beside the disabled reveal button.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 and 06 show explicit identity choices, First name and privacy text; runtime reports selection semantics, retention and validation.
findings: Reflow the two identity choices vertically at 200% so Someone and its checkmark remain together.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show expanded reasoning, assumptions and sources; runtime reports Enter operation, heading focus, return focus and preserved full content.
findings: Introduce smaller independently collapsible evidence sections to improve scanning of long fixtures.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: The supplied runtime describes Preparing image, synchronous duplicate prevention, an available Invite action, injected failure recovery and successful PNG download; busy/error frames are not pictured.
findings: Include busy and failed-export screenshots to make the status presentation directly reviewable.

components.name: Outcome selector
components.evidence: Sheets 05 and 13–14 show three outcome choices, selected checkmarks and persistent saved labels, with persistence reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Increase the outcome group’s prominence on check-in screens relative to Share.

components.name: Close, Back and progress controls
components.evidence: Flow screens consistently place Close or Back at the upper left and progress or balance at the upper right; runtime reports answer preservation on Back.
findings: Keep the contextual return destination explicit where a chevron alone could mean either leaving the flow or revisiting an answer.

limitations: These are provisional browser grades based on the attached sheets and supplied runtime narrative; no independent interaction drive or artifact-file inspection was performed.
Scores reflect visible defects and component-specific evidence rather than a blanket penalty for deferred native checks; no full/native 9 or 10 certification is given.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, with genuinely inapplicable dimensions excluded.
The A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and component; strong atmospheric coherence does not erase enlarged-form and evidence-reading friction.

No blocked browser task, data loss or confirmed inaccessible primary control is established by these materials; content below a screenshot boundary is not assumed unreachable when runtime reports scrolling.
Transition pairs show broadly consistent framing but cannot independently establish focus continuity, intermediate-frame legibility or absence of layout shifts.
Some keyboard, contrast and recovery evidence is explicitly carried forward from unchanged components; current coverage is reported rather than independently reproduced here.

Synthetic forecasts, long reasoning and source fixtures establish layout stress only; their wording, repetitions and date relationships are not treated as production-copy defects or model-quality evidence.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, hardware keyboard/VoiceOver, microphone, haptics, real payments, configured social/Auth services and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Offline Sky and Circles are honestly represented fallback states; successful social creation or delivery is not demonstrated.
Focus visibility, target sizes, announcements and every possible animated-background contrast combination cannot be established solely from the sheets.
Outcome screens include different apparent scroll positions; cropped orbs there are not independently established as layout bugs.
topFixes: Reflow enlarged identity choices and increase enlarged question-field height so selection markers and question context remain readable together.
Reduce discretionary space above question forms to improve primary-action visibility without shrinking enlarged text.
Break long explanations into labeled, independently collapsible context, assumption and source sections.
Prioritize outcome selection on check-in screens and make saved notices more compact.
Add explicit prerequisite guidance beside disabled birth-detail and offline Circle actions.
Provide an inspectable share preview with an accessible text equivalent and directly pictured export busy/error states.
